title: Traverse already-validated immutable packed fields
question: Can traversal reuse packed-field UTF-8 invariants without weakening input validation?
summary: Remove repeated traversal validation while preserving strict CSV/spool construction checks and immutable views.

workloads: One million probe-v1 pipeline rows, four workers, 32-MiB job/shared limits and larger fixed output caps.

validation.summary: Recorded exact output/Analysis comparisons and construction, corruption and ownership controls cover the pinned builds; external input remains validated.

limitations: Small development cells and uncontrolled cache/background state do not establish general device, shape or tail performance.
Historical percentage gains are not additive; every comparison uses its own pinned baseline.
Unchecked traversal depends on validated construction, cleared recycled storage, bounds checks and immutable views.
exclusions: Earlier 200k-row/small-cap panels and rejected parser samples are different comparisons.
